items.text: Nico Collins ruled OUT for Sunday (hamstring). Confirmed across ETR Sunday injury list and Schefter/Rapoport.
items.implication: Major target vacuum in HOU passing game.

items.text: Rico Dowdle ruled OUT (toe). Jaylen Warren expected to lead PIT RB group with checkdown/volume bump.
items.why: Toe injury; coach: Warren will lead and stay fresh.
items.implication: Warren clear lead back; practice squad depth behind.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries, routes, checkdowns for Warren vs CIN.

items.text: Jayden Daniels ruled OUT; Marcus Mariota starts. Positive longer-term notes but inactive this week.
items.implication: WAS offense shift; lower ceiling for pass-catchers short-term.

items.text: Puka Nacua DOUBTFUL/not expected to play Sunday (hip); McVay optimistic for next week vs PHI. Davante Adams to carry load.
items.why: Hip; DNP, McVay: not great progress, possible return next.
items.implication: Adams primary target; high route/target share sans Nacua.
items.opportunity: Adams 42% target rate on routes without Nacua historically; prior big games.

items.text: Projecting Qs Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) IN as of now despite listings. Clarity hoped on Flowers/Moore etc.
items.implication: Startable if confirmed; monitor early news.

items.text: JK Dobbins and RJ Harvey IN/ACTIVE (off injury report); Jonah Coleman OUT (ankle).
items.why: Off IR/report; good to go vs Rams.
items.implication: DEN RB committee full; Coleman absence reverse prior handcuff.
items.opportunity: Shared carries; monitor split for usage.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs sets new ETR ceiling projection record at 44.0 (top 25th %ile sim avg) for Week 3 main slate.
items.why: Sim ceilings live; highest ever noted.
items.implication: Elite upside play; smash in favorable spots.
items.opportunity: High snap/target/carry ceiling in DET offense.

items.text: With Dowdle OUT, Jaylen Warren will lead PIT RBs; vertical pass not working so expect checkdown spam. Projecting Warren (Q shoulder) in.
items.why: Coach comments + Dowdle out; practice squad Homer/Heidenreich backups.
items.implication: High volume RB2/flex with receiving upside.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks to IR (limited career games); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead role (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup.
Davante Adams ran 142 routes without Nacua as Ram, targeted 42%. Prior misses: big TDs/yards.
items.why: Historical route/target data when Nacua out.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush prop 88.5; DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% targets both games; RB7 util; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts, high aDOT; LV allows 18.7 ypr to WRs) and Dalton Schultz @ IND (28% tgt share sans Collins; IND 4th-most TE yds).
items.why: Usage + matchups; Collins out boosts Schultz.

items.text: Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (post-fumble 31% snaps/5 touches; JAX stingy vs RBs) and Travis Etienne vs LV (low util/snaps even with Kamara; role not there).
items.implication: Sit or fade; Henderson gap narrowed but Stevenson still ahead.
